description: No one does anything to her. They simply stop - which is not actionable anywhere, by anyone, ever.
energy_note: Nothing was done to her. Everything stopped.

description: Where the sanction extends to relatives, the cost of maintaining contact is borne by them too, which is how compliance is enforced.
energy_note: Her mother is not allowed to phone her.

description: It is one sentence at the end of the notices, using the formal wording. Nobody looks round. By the Wednesday her sister has stopped replying, and no one has said a word to her.
energy_note: One sentence, and a silence that lasts years.
